title: 风险名单
hierarchy: World -> EventArc -> Game -> Scene -> Round -> Action

game:cause-reconstruction.objective: 重建名单异常的技术/数据/方法因果链，确定哪些解释可被证据支持。

game:72h-briefing.objective: 在72小时内形成不超出证据的联合初步说明。

game:pilot-decision.objective: 决定试点暂停、缩窄还是继续，以及人工复核范围。
game:pilot-decision.opens_when: enough verified incident facts exist to make an operational choice

game:leak-path.objective: 查清截图如何离开内部工作流，以及这件事改变了谁的行为和责任压力。

initial_scenes.purpose: 确认异常名单、截图时间和当前批次不一致，并冻结昨夜所有批次。
initial_scenes.exit: 技术侧成为下一合法信息源

initial_scenes.purpose: 重建三次运行、回滚、手工重跑和输入快照差异。
initial_scenes.exit: 医院随访侧被解锁；旧版本解释被证明不充分

initial_scenes.purpose: 把已知事实压缩成可对上级使用的语言，同时避免把未证实因果写成结论。

cross_game_bridges.forbidden: private suspicion automatically becoming official language

cross_game_bridges.allowed_bridge: bounded risk estimate or validated failure mode
cross_game_bridges.forbidden: technical team deciding operational policy by itself

cross_game_bridges.allowed_bridge: publicly observable leak or verified distribution path

role_rule: Roles are game-local. No actor receives a global hero/villain tag. The same act can protect a legitimate good in one game and impose a cost in another.
scene_rule: A scene may contain multiple rounds and should end only when the local action set changes, a deadline interrupts, participants separate, or local convergence/deadlock occurs.
next_engine_step: Materialize Round 3 as at least one hospital-side scene with multiple rounds. Do not add a new core actor unless the active games actually require that person's information, authority or relationship.
